sourceObservations.observation: Runtime discovery scans applicable engine/project extension roots, separates extension children, merges supported-platform/module data and resolves offered plugin versions. Its directory traversal stops below a discovered plugin and excludes Content directories. The wrapper's recursive descriptor catalog is therefore a conservative inventory, not proof that every catalog member is discovered or enabled.

Receipt plugin overrides, BuildPlugins, descriptor runtime dependencies and runtime enablement have separate meanings. BuildPlugins supplies an optional-dependency allowlist in the applicable runtime branch. Normal configuration processes compile-time information, command-line requests, target/project/default requests and program requests in order.

Normal loading excludes ExplicitlyLoaded plugins. PreInitPostStartupScreen calls LoadStartupModules under WITH_ENGINE; the dispatcher processes PreDefault, Default and PostDefault, with project loading first and short-circuit failure returns. This supports conditional source reachability of the proof modules, not observed execution.

Public MountExplicitlyLoadedPlugin and private MountPluginFromExternalSource both default MaxLoadingPhase to ELoadingPhase::Max. The mount implementation iterates phases below that bound, skips None, ignores TryLoadModulesForPlugin return values and subsequently marks the plugin mounted. Its success Boolean must not be interpreted as proof that every module loaded successfully.
